description:
Scales shows you one of your own thoughts at a time, and helps you question it.

Write down what's on your mind: a line from a book, something someone said, a rule you're trying to keep. Scales hands each thought back later, and how long you stay decides when it returns.

Swipe up to move on. Pull down to put a thought away, and say why if you like. Tap to edit it or add a note. Undo stays for five seconds.

THINK IT THROUGH
Your own thoughts are the hardest to question. You can't see your own assumptions, you argue against yourself badly, and you can't hold every thought at once. On an iPhone with Apple Intelligence, Scales helps with each:
- Argue with it: the strongest honest case against a thought and the belief it rests on, the case for it, and what you'd be let off if the case against won.
- Tensions: pairs of your own thoughts that pull against each other, side by side.
- Themes and your week: your thoughts grouped by theme.
It never tells you what to think, and it all runs on your iPhone.

SEE WHAT'S CHANGING
Insights shows what you actually did: thoughts you used to skip and now stay with, what you've put away and why, how your wording has changed, and what you're still avoiding. Counted on your phone. No streaks, no scores.

ONE THOUGHT AT A TIME
There are no ratings and no buttons to judge a thought. One you keep glancing past comes back a little bolder; one you stay with rests longer. Each day brings up to 30, chosen so every thought comes round. Nothing disappears on its own, and anything you put away is one tap from coming back.

Start with sets of lines worth keeping (The Stoics, Franklin's Virtues, Know Yourself, After Jung, Questions to Sit With), or bring in your own from a list, a CSV or Kindle highlights. Find any thought in Your thoughts, by where you stand with it. Choose a Pistachio, Plum or Bone icon.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
No account. Nothing you write leaves your phone. No ads, no tracking. Scales saves a copy to your own iCloud Drive each time you leave it.

Argue with it, Tensions and Themes need Apple Intelligence on a supported iPhone (iPhone 15 Pro or later, iOS 26). Everything else works on any iPhone, with or without a connection.
promotionalText: Your own thoughts are the hardest to question. Scales hands them back one at a time, argues the other side, and keeps it all on your phone.
subtitle: Write it down. Let it return.
